title: Stage the Nubia NX809J deployment bundle and guarded phone scripts
headline: A hash-pinned, fail-closed offline bundle and phone runbook are staged, but no execution is authorized: there is no app runner and all staged SM8850 Parakeet contexts compile at QNN 2.40 rather than the exact programme pin QAIRT 2.45.0.260326154327.

evidence_policy.unknowns: Remain blockers; no compatibility, app or placement result is inferred

version_contract.refusal_point: Before any context is handed to QNN

bundle.commit_policy: Large model, audio and Qualcomm runtime payloads remain ignored; only small control-plane scripts, manifests and marker files are force-added to the lane commit.

runtime.licence_boundary: Runtime object code must be incorporated into the authorized application under the bundled Qualcomm licence and notice.

host_assumptions: POSIX shell and normal POSIX utilities
device_assumptions: run-as enabled for the authorized harness package
script_contract.device_selection: Exactly one adb row and it must be state=device; verify NX809J, SM8850 and arm64-v8a properties
script_contract.hashing: Local payload and runtime bytes are streamed through device toybox sha256sum; installed files are hashed at final app-owned paths
script_contract.ownership: Package-manager UID must equal run-as UID; root, shell and non-package inference processes are rejected
script_contract.networking: Any adb forward is rejected; run.sh forces and verifies airplane mode
script_contract.runtime_mapping: collect.sh rejects QNN mappings from /system or /vendor
mismatch_signatures: Using newer context binary on old SDK
Can't create context from binary. Error 5000

checks: direct NPU request blocks on 2.40/2.45 mismatch
one mocked NX809J/SM8850 arm64 target accepted

hard_blocks: CPU_STAGE_ONLY: no complete CPU five-language stack is staged
Zero exact-2.45 QNN contexts are staged
The staged 2.40 Parakeet contexts must never be paired with the staged 2.45 runtime
E1 account cannot currently select SM8850 for the required Parakeet recompile
next_authorized_actions: Integrate a hash-pinned app-UID runner and exact one QAIRT provider
Acquire or compile SM8850 contexts at exact 2.45 and register their hashes
Integrate the selected complete CPU and/or NPU stack from lanes A-D
Then follow PHONE_RUNBOOK.md when the phone is physically available
